item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00407","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C14","C17"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 is the strongest plausible drafting template because both letters transmit two health-related legislative proposals, introduce them through a first-proposal/other-proposal sequence, briefly explain the function and benefit of each, refer readers to supporting material from the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare, and close with a favorable recommendation. C14 has a similar two-bill and HEW-letter structure, but its descriptions are more compressed and its subject is education. C17 parallels the creation of a new governmental institution and referral to an enclosed explanatory letter, but lacks the child's distinctive paired-proposal organization.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am enclosing for consideration by the Congress a draft bill to authorize the Surgeon General to establish within the Public Health Service a National Institute of Child Health and Human Development and a National Institute of General Medical Sciences.","parent_excerpt":"I am transmitting herewith two drafts of legislation to carry out recommendations I made in my message to the Congress on February ninth.","explanation":"Both open by transmitting legislation comprising two related health initiatives."},{"child_excerpt":"One of these two Institutes will deal with child health and human development... The other proposal will convert the Division of General Medical Sciences in the Public Health Service into an Institute","parent_excerpt":"The first bill would, when enacted, increase opportunities for training physicians, dentists and professional public health personnel... The other bill which I am transmitting will help expand and improve community facilities and services for the health care of the aged and other persons.","explanation":"Both use a parallel first/one proposal followed by an 'other' proposal, explaining each component separately."},{"child_excerpt":"The purposes and functions of both of the new Institutes are outlined in detail in the attached letter from the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare. I urge the favorable consideration of the proposal.","parent_excerpt":"The enclosed letters from the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare describe the two proposals in more detail. I commend this legislation to you.","explanation":"The closing machinery is closely parallel: supporting HEW material supplies further detail, followed by a concise request for congressional approval."}]}
